results.title: India Shines at Para Asian Games with Multiple Golds in Athletics
results.description: India's remarkable journey at the Para Asian Games is highlighted by Dilip Gavit's gold in the men's 400 m T47 and Solairaj Dharmaraj's record-setting long jump. With a total of 88 medals, including 21 golds, India's para-athletes continue to shine across various events. The excitement doesn't stop there, as more medals were secured in swimming and badminton, showcasing the country's depth of talent. Discover the inspiring stories behind these achievements and the athletes who are making history.

results.title: CreditAccess Grameen posts four-fold jump in profit
results.description: CreditAccess Grameen posted a four-fold increase in Q2 net profit to Rs 501.57 crore, driven by strong net interest income growth, lower credit costs, and improved asset quality.

results.title: Hockey Haryana Triumphs Over Madhya Pradesh in National Championship Final
results.description: In a thrilling final at the 16th Hockey India Senior Men National Championship 2026, Hockey Haryana overcame Hockey Madhya Pradesh with a score of 2-1. The match saw Madhya Pradesh take an early lead, but Haryana's resilience shone through as they equalized and then scored the winning goal. Meanwhile, Uttar Pradesh Hockey claimed third place by defeating Hockey Punjab 3-1. This championship showcased intense competition and remarkable performances from all teams involved.
